repo: GSD plan:pre hook registry classifies phases via a `when` condition — the UI capability hook only activates for net-new UI surface phases, so architecture/refactor phases like 68.2 correctly get zero UI gate hooks even though the lower-level ui-plan-gate check reports block:true

`gsd-tools query commit` frequently reports `commit_failed` as a false negative even when the commit lands cleanly in git log — must verify with git log rather than trust the reported status (recurring across multiple commits this session)

worktree.baseRef config ('head' vs default 'fresh'/origin-main) determines whether spawned executor worktrees fork from live HEAD (seeing all PLAN.md files) or from stale origin/main — critical to check before dispatching any worktree-based executor

In this pnpm monorepo, worktree executors each need their own `pnpm install`, which is expensive; sequential execution on the main tree reuses installed node_modules and is preferred when most waves are single-plan
intel API-surface extraction (§7.9) returns 0 symbols for this monorepo — it's HINT-only, so it's fine to omit from planner prompts when empty
gap-analysis.plan-post check's `rendered` field can contain control characters that break naive parsing — call the check directly instead of relying on that field
